answer: Each identity binds one human fingerprint as a pearl template hashed on-chain, with a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch a random 6-digit vertex code triggers a scan in 10 minutes; match above 0.96 passes, a duplicate print slashes both bonds, and two missed scans forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts. Forging 100 identities needs 100 real fingers: each fake adds a finger plus 25 POA, and brokered prints double every 50 sold, so 100 fakes lock 2,500 POA plus 100 scans. A quill-signed residence proof exempts household fingers; every hash and scan sits on-chain for verifiers to replay.
